source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entries 999–1001 add the AUTF8String storeToken attribute, move callers to GetStoreToken/SetStoreToken and remove the public messageOffset API. Accepted code retains the typed attribute. The earlier compaction lesson already covers the opaque store mapping; this narrower API pattern replaces repeated string-property spellings in ordinary callers. Backend-specific mbox code can parse a 64-bit offset, while Maildir treats the token as a filename. Do not add an mbox-only messageOffset attribute back to the common header interface.
title: Use the typed storeToken API without treating its string as a message key
